task.question: By up to how much does HarnessFix improve performance over the initial harnesses?
task.evidence: We evaluate HarnessFix on four popular benchmarks, and results show that it improves the performance over the initial harnesses by 6.3% to 18.4%, significantly outperforming human-designed and self-evolution baselines.

answer:
HarnessFix improves performance over the initial harnesses by up to 44.9% on Repairs, 35.4% on HumanEval, and 38.1% on EvalPlus. 

FINAL: Up to 44.9% (Repairs), 35.4% (HumanEval), 38.1% (EvalPlus).
